div.p: Best for certification questions, invoices and directory listings.

A 30-minute video or phone call to discuss sessions, events or the certification pathway.
Tell us a little about what you are looking for, your availability, and any questions.

details.summary: I want to try TRE™. What is the first step?
details.p: Book a free discovery call or pick a certified provider from the directory. Most people start with a 60–90 minute individual session or an introductory group session, then continue with three to four sessions to establish a safe self-practice.

details.summary: I'm a certified provider. How do I get listed?
details.p: Choose "Being listed in the provider directory" in the form and include your certification status, Certifying Trainer, bio, areas served, languages and contact details. Listing is free; profiles go live within a week. See what to send.

details.summary: Can you run a session for my company?
details.p: Yes — lunch-and-learns, half-day workshops, offsite modules and multi-week programmes, in person in Singapore or online. Choose "A corporate wellbeing programme" and tell us your team size and dates.

details.summary: Which time zone do you work in?
details.p: Events are scheduled in Singapore time (SGT, UTC+8). Isabelle is based between Singapore and Japan (JST, UTC+9), so replies typically arrive during Asian business hours.
